3 Pro Tips to Master Fast-Paced Multiplayer Action in Modern Warfare 4 🎯👇

​To dominate the map, you need more than just quick reflexes. Here is what you need to focus on to improve your gameplay:

​1️⃣ Master Movement Tech: Fast, frenetic pacing means positioning is everything. Practice jump-shotting and sliding into cover to break enemy lines of sight.

2️⃣ Learn Map Layouts: Understanding chokepoints and verticality gives you a huge advantage when coordinating killstreaks and controlling the map.

3️⃣ Optimize Tool Usage: Use killstreaks and secondary equipment strategically to force enemies out of hiding.
